RISK:
Technological
Changes in technology are
a continuous threat to the
operations.
MITIGATION:
• The Group ensures that its operating systems
are updated and protected from external
threats.

RISK:
Process execution
The inability to properly
assess a situation and
deploy the right strategy.
MITIGATION:
• By ensuring that the business strategy is
well discussed and articulated to all process
owners.

RISK:
Internal/ External fraud
The risk of employee
and external party fraud
through collusion.
MITIGATION:
• Group constantly reviews updates to its
internal controls and monitors the utilisation
of its resources.

RISK:
Safety
Resulting from the risk
of violation of workplace
safety measures.
MITIGATION:
• The environmental and safety team
ensures adherence to safety measures and
compliances to regulatory authority.

RISK:
Business practices
The risk of release of
wrong information
accidental or otherwise.
MITIGATION:
• Ensuring that the company data is well
protected and in compliance to data safety
requirements.
